title: eSpring基金经理ChristinaWoon：韩国市场受散户资金扰动
speaker: Christina Woon

segments.en: So that's the way I would frame the AI trade at this point. How do you feel about career now?
segments.zh: 这就是我目前对AI交易的理解。你现在怎么看韩国市场？

segments.en: Well, I think career still has the select memory names. The fundamentals there are still quite strong. You're still seeing memory prices holding up and actually increasing as well.
segments.zh: 我认为韩国市场仍有一些精选的存储类标的。基本面依然相当强劲，存储价格仍在上涨。

segments.en: I think that tightness and supply is still intact. The difficulty that we've seen or the added dynamic that's really come in has been from a flow perspective because the retail investor started to become a larger proportion of that and that can be quite volatile or add volatility to that trade as well.
segments.zh: 我认为供应紧张的局面依然存在。但我们看到的困难或新增的动态来自资金流方面，因为散户投资者开始占据更大比例，这可能会增加波动性。

segments.en: We've seen leverage ETFs, also be another dynamic that retail players have also participated in. So flows is something that's been a bit difficult to ignore. I would say is a dynamic we have to consider as well.
segments.zh: 我们还看到杠杆ETF，这也是散户参与的另一个动态。所以资金流是一个不容忽视的因素，我们必须考虑。

segments.en: And then starting today, you're seeing rebalancing domestically within PS2. So again, with career, while there are interesting stocks there that have structural runs, the flows part is something investors should keep in eye on.
segments.zh: 从今天开始，PS2内部也在进行国内再平衡。所以对于韩国市场，虽然有一些结构性上涨的标的，但资金流方面投资者需要密切关注。
